documents.title: DOC 74 - 2026 Monza Event - INFRINGEMENT - Car 2 - start set up procedure
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 2 - start set up procedure

details.fact: Car 2 (Durksen) did not engage the start set up procedure before coming to a halt after the Formation Lap.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 37.9 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Reprimand to the Driver of Car 2.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Document 71) and heard the Driver of Car 2 (Durksen) and the team representative. The Technical Delegate showed the data to the Stewards and the Driver and Team Representative. The driver of Car 2 explained that, at the end of the formation lap on the main straight, he was focused on building tyre temperature and ensuring that he stopped correctly within his grid box. He stated that he activated the start set-up procedure once the car had come to a stop in its designated grid position. The Team Representative explained that the race engineer had reminded the driver to activate the start set-up procedure when entering the grid. The Team also confirmed, based on its data, that the procedure had been activated prior to the start of the race. The Technical Delegate reported that Car 2 did not have the start set-up procedure activated before coming to a halt on the grid. However, the procedure was activated more than 30 seconds before the start signal was given. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that the start set- up procedure was activated after the car had stopped on the grid, which constituted a breach of Article 37.9 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations . However, the procedure was activated well before the start of the race, thereby avoiding any potentially dangerous situation. Taking these mitigating circumstances into account, the Stewards elect to impose a Reprimand on the driver of Car 2.

documents.title: DOC 73 - 2026 Monza Event - INFRINGEMENT - Car 8 - breach of RD instructions - tyre pit lane management
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 8 - breach of RD instructions - tyre pit lane management

details.fact: During the mandatory pit stop for Car 8 (Bilinski), the rear left tyre was rolled across the working area from one team member to another.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: Warning given to the Competitor.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Document 57) and heard the team representatives. They examined video evidence. Following the pit stop of Car 8, the mechanic responsible for the left-rear tyre passed a tyre to his colleague on the right-rear side by rolling it across the pit stop box. The mechanic on the right-rear side caught the tyre and dropped it behind him, causing the tyre to momentarily rock in its position. The Team Representative acknowledged that the handling of the tyre could have been carried out in a better manner. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that, although the tyre only rocked momentarily and it did not roll when it was dropped by Car 8's mechanic, the tyre handling procedure was not carried out to the standard expected. On this occasion, the operation did not create an unsafe situation. However, passing tyres between mechanics by rolling them across the pit stop box has the potential to create a dangerous situation should the tyre not be caught correctly and instead rebound towards the fast lane. In light of the above, the Stewards elect to impose a Warning on the Team.

documents.title: DOC 72 - 2026 Monza Event - INFRINGEMENT - Car 12 - breach of RD instructions - tyre pit lane management
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 12 - breach of RD instructions - tyre pit lane management

details.fact: During the mandatory pit stop for Car 12 (Boya), the rear left wheel rolled away from the team member towards the fast lane rather than being placed immediately flat.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: A fine of 500 Euros to be paid by the Competitor. In accordance with Article 12.8.1 of the ISC, fines shall be paid within forty‐eight hours of their notification by means of bank transfer to the FIA.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Document 62) and heard the team representatives. They examined video evidence. The team representative admitted that the left rear tyre of Car 12 rocked momentarily during the tyre change. Video evidence confirmed that the left rear tyre of Car 12 rolled in the working area for Car 12. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that during the pit stop of Car 12 (Boya), the left rear tyre removed from the car was not placed flat on the ground in a stable condition by a PREMA Racing team member. Consequently, the tyre rolled away from the pit stop position before coming to rest. This was contrary to Item 2(iii) of the Race Director Competition Notes – Tyres and Pit Stop Procedures, which requires tyres removed from cars during pit stops to be placed flat on the ground in a stable condition. The standard fine is assessed and the team is reminded of the safety issues that can result from tyres not being placed flat and securely in the pit lane.

documents.title: DOC 68 - 2026 Monza Event - INFRINGEMENT - Car 11 - causing a collision
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 11 - causing a collision

details.fact: Car 11 (Montoya) made contact with Car 4 (Herta) on the approach to Turn 8.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 (d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: Ten seconds (10) time penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (b) of the FIA F2 Sporting Regulations. In addition, 2 points to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 4 points.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Documents 60 & 61) and heard the Drivers of Car 11 (Montoya) and Car 4 (Herta) and the team representatives. They examined video evidence. The Driver of Car 4 stated that, while exiting Turn 7, he was following Car 11 and observed Car 11 making several changes of direction along the straight. He further explained that, as he initiated an overtaking manoeuvre on the left-hand side, Car 11 made a final sudden move towards the left, crowding him towards the edge of the track. This resulted in contact between the front wing of Car 4 and the left-rear tyre of Car 11. The Driver of Car 11 stated that Car 4 was following him close after Turn 7 and that he had moved to the left-hand side of the track before Car 4 attempted the overtake. He maintained that Car 4 subsequently made contact with his left-rear tyre. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that Car 11 made multiple changes of direction on the straight, with the final move being a reaction to the overtaking attempt by Car 4. The Stewards therefore find Car 11 wholly responsible for the collision and impose the standard penalty of a 10-second time penalty and two (2) penalty points.

documents.title: DOC 64 - 2026 Monza Event - INFRINGEMENT - Car 14 - forced another car off track
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 14 - forced another car off track

details.fact: Car 14 (Stenshorne) forced Car 22 (Varrone) off track at Turn 5.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L Chapter IV, Article 2 (b) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: Ten seconds (10) time penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (b) of the FIA F2 Sporting Regulations. In addition, 2 points to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 6 points.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. Approaching Turn 4, Car 8 was leading a group of cars, closely followed by Car 14 and Car 22. At the exit of Turn 5, Car 14 made minor contact with the rear of Car 8, resulting in the loss of the right-wing endplate. Immediately thereafter, Car 22 initiated an overtaking manoeuvre on Car 14. During this manoeuvre, Car 14 moved from the left-hand side of the track towards the right- hand side while Car 22 had its front wing alongside Car 14's sidepod. As a result, Car 22 was forced towards the edge of the track and ended up placing two wheels on the grass, losing momentum and falling behind Car 14. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that Car 14 made a defensive move on the straight in an attempt to prevent Car 22 from overtaking. In doing so, Car 14 failed to leave at least one car width between its own car and the edge of the track. The Stewards therefore concluded that Car 14 was wholly responsible for crowding Car 22 off the track between Turns 5 and 6.

documents.title: DOC 49 - 2026 Monza Event - DECISION - Car 22 - alleged contact with Car 1 in Race 1
documents.subject: DECISION - Car 22 - alleged contact with Car 1 in Race 1

details.fact: Car 22 (Varrone) made contact with Car 1 (Camara) at Turn 1.
details.infringement: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 (d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: No further action.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Documents 47 & 48) and heard the Drivers of Car 1 (Camara) and Car 22 (Varrone) and the team representatives. They examined video footage and onboard evidence. The Driver of Car 1 explained that, upon entering Turn 1, the cars ahead of him slowed more than he had anticipated. He therefore had to reduce his speed but he made contact with Car 3 who was ahead of him. The Driver of Car 22 explained that, upon entering Turn 1, he saw Car 1 ahead suddenly move to the left-hand side of the track while travelling at reduced speed. At the same time, Car 23 was running alongside him on his outside, leaving him with no available space to move further to the outside. The Driver of Car 22 stated that he attempted to reduce his speed as soon as he noticed Car 1 slowing, at the apex of Turn 2, when Car 23 made contact with Car 1, and ultimately Car 22 also made contact with Car 1. Having considered the circumstances of the incident, the Stewards considered that neither Driver could be considered wholly or predominantly responsible for the collision. Taking all the circumstances into consideration, the Stewards determined that Car 22 was not blame for the incident and decided that No Further Action was appropriate.

documents.title: DOC 41 - 2026 Monza Event - INFRINGEMENT - Car 16 - driving in breach of RD instructions
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 16 - driving in breach of RD instructions

details.fact: Car 16 (Maini) was involved in the incident on the approach to Turn 11 towards the end of Qualifying.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code - Race Director Competition Notes Item 18.
details.decision: A drop of 3 places on the grid for the Sprint Race & Feature Race at this Competition. In addition, 2 points to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 3 points
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Document 28) and heard the Driver of Car 16 (Maini) and the team representative. They examined video evidence. The Race Director Competition Notes, Item 18 Practice and Qualifying Etiquette provides that “drivers not on a fast lap must make all efforts to keep off the racing line” and “At no point during Practice/Qualifying should drivers remain side by side”. The Stewards determined that Car 16 (Maini), while on a preparation lap, was driving slowly in the middle of the track between Turn 10 & Turn 11, and remained side by side with another car which was not on the racing line. The Stewards considered that Car 16 was in breach of the above provisions of the Competition Notes and did not comply with the Race Director’s instructions concerning Qualifying etiquette. Taking all the circumstances into consideration, the Stewards decided that a drop of three grid positions for both the Sprint Race and the Feature Race at this Competition, together with 2 penalty points to be added to the Driver’s record, was appropriate.

documents.title: DOC 38 - 2026 Monza Event - INFRINGEMENT - Car 12 - driving unnecessarily slowly
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 12 - driving unnecessarily slowly

details.fact: Car 12 (Boya) was driving unnecessarily slowly off the racing line on the approach to Turn 11.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 (e) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: A drop of 3 places on the grid for the Sprint Race & Feature Race at this Competition. In addition, 2 points to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 4 points
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Document 24) and heard the Driver of Car 12 (Boya) and the team representative. They examined video evidence. During the session, Car 12, which was leading a group of cars, slowed significantly on the exit of Turn 10 and began warming its tyres. The driver then moved to the right- hand side of the track, leaving the racing line clear to the left. Several cars approaching from behind elected to momentarily queue behind Car 12 rather than continue at normal speed on the racing line. The speed of Car 12 reduced to approximately 31 km/h. As additional cars caught the group, this resulted in two and, at times, three lines of cars travelling side by side at low speed, including on the racing line. The driver of Car 12 explained that he was leading a group of cars and chose to slow down in order to avoid providing a tow to the cars behind. He acknowledged that he reduced speed significantly, including selecting first gear, but stated that he was travelling off the racing line at all times. He further explained that he avoided accelerating and braking aggressively in order to avoid driving erratically. The Stewards acknowledge that there are occasions during practice and qualifying sessions when drivers may need to slow significantly off the racing line, or even come to a stop, in order to avoid impeding another car. Such circumstances may constitute driving "necessarily" slowly. In this case, however, the Stewards determined that Car 12 slowed to an excessively low speed without a valid sporting or safety justification. The sole purpose of this action was to seek a sporting advantage by avoiding providing a tow and potentially benefiting from one later in the lap. By doing so, Car 12 contributed to the formation of a queue of cars travelling at very low speed and to the circumstances that led to incidents involving multiple cars approaching Turn 11. Having carefully considered the matter, the Stewards conclude that Car 12 was driving unnecessarily slowly. Accordingly, they impose the standard penalty of a three grid place drop for both the Sprint Race and the Feature Race, together with two penalty points.

documents.title: DOC 36 - 2026 Monza Event - DECISION - Car 8 - alleged weaving in Qualifying
documents.subject: DECISION - Car 8 - alleged weaving in Qualifying

details.fact: Car 8 (Bilinski) was alleged to be weaving in a zone prohibited by the Race Director Competition Notes.
details.infringement: Alleged breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: No further action.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Document 23) and heard the Driver of Car 8 (Bilinski) and the team representative. They examined video evidence. The Driver of Car 8 explained that he was encountering a slow-moving queue of cars ahead, particularly after the second bridge following Turn 10, where the Race Director had specifically instructed drivers to maintain full pace and avoid travelling at slow speed on the racing line. The Driver of Car 8 further explained that he understood the Race Director’s instructions and therefore chose to overtake the queue. As there were cars running side-by-side ahead of him, he had to move further to the left, onto the racing line, in order to avoid this complex situation while maintaining full pace. In doing so, the Driver of Car 8 stated that he had to place two wheels on the edge of the track. After passing the queue and being ahead of the other cars before entering Turn 11, he subsequently weaved the car in order to remove dust and debris from the tyres, with the intention of having clean tyres for his final push lap of the session. He also admitted being aware that no other cars were close to him and that he was travelling at racing speed. Taking all the circumstances into consideration, the Stewards decided that No Further Action was appropriate.

documents.title: DOC 35 - 2026 Monza Event - INFRINGEMENT - Car 6 - driving in an erratic manner
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 6 - driving in an erratic manner

details.fact: Car 6 (Tsolov) was weaving in an erratic manner, close to Car 11 (Montoya) on the approach to Turn 11.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 (e) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: A drop of 3 places on the grid for the Sprint Race & Feature Race at this Competition. In addition, 2 points to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 6 points
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Documents 29 & 27) and heard the Drivers of Car 6 (Tsolov) and Car 11 (Montoya) and the team representatives. They examined video evidence. The Driver of Car 11 explained that he saw Car 8 begin a flying lap and decided to follow him. He further stated that, as he approached Turn 11, he observed Car 6 warming its tyres on the racing line. To avoid a potential collision, he took avoiding action and left the track. The Driver of Car 6 explained that he was behind Car 12 and, after seeing several other cars begin their laps, decided to do the same. He stated that the cars ahead were attempting to create a gap before starting their laps, and he therefore began warming his tyres. He acknowledged that there were other cars behind but admitted that he did not expect Car 11 to be so close until he saw it alongside him. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that Car 6 was driving erratically by warming its tyres on the racing line while not travelling at racing speed. As a result, Car 11 was forced to take avoiding action and leave the track. The Stewards therefore determined that Car 6 hindered Car 11 and elect to impose a three grid place penalty for both the Sprint Race and the Feature Race, together with two penalty points.

documents.title: DOC 34 - 2026 Monza Event - INFRINGEMENT - Car 9 - impeded Car 21 in Qualifying
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 9 - impeded Car 21 in Qualifying

details.fact: Car 9 (Mini) impeded Car 21 (Shields) between Turn 9 and Turn 11 in Qualifying.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 31.6 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: A drop of 3 places on the grid for the Sprint Race & Feature Race at this Competition. No driver penalty points are associated with this infringement.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Documents 21 & 22) and heard the Drivers of Car 9 (Mini) and Car 21 (Shields) and the team representatives. They examined video evidence, marshalling sectors and GPS data. The Driver of Car 21 explained that he was on his final flying lap when he observed Car 9, ahead of him, leaving the track at Turn 9. He further stated that Car 9 did not activate DRS on the subsequent straight. The Driver of Car 21 was expecting Car 9 to move off the racing line before Turn 11, but Car 9 remained on the racing line, resulting in Car 21 being unnecessarily impeded. The Driver of Car 9 admitted making a mistake at Turn 9, placing his tyres in the gravel and consequently losing speed. He acknowledged being aware that Car 21 was approaching on a push lap but admitted that he misjudged the situation with the car behind. GPS data and video evidence confirmed that Car 9 did not activate DRS between Turns 10 and 11. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that Car 9 unnecessarily impeded Car 21. Accordingly, they impose the standard penalty of a three-grid-place drop for both the Sprint Race and the Feature Race at this Competition.

documents.title: DOC 32 - 2026 Monza Event - INFRINGEMENT - Car 11 - track limit violation
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 11 - track limit violation

details.fact: Car 11 (Montoya) went off track at Turn 11 at 15:23 in Qualifying.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations and alleged breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the FIA ISC - Race Director Competition Notes item 17.2.
details.decision: Lap time cancellation of 2:36.828 when Car 11 went off track at Turn 11.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. Approaching Turn 11, Car 6 (Tsolov) was ahead of Car 11 (Montoya). On the approach to the corner, Car 6 began a tyre- warming manoeuvre, which resulted in Car 11 taking avoiding action and subsequently exceeding the track limits. The video evidence showed that Car 11 rejoined the track at a reduced speed and did not gain any lasting advantage as a result of leaving the track. Having carefully considered the matter, the Stewards determined that Car 11 left the track at the entry of Turn 11 solely as a consequence of taking avoiding action. As no advantage was gained, the Stewards decided to invalidate only the lap during which Car 11 left the track and not the immediately following lap, as provided for in item 17.2 of the Race Director's Competition Notes.

documents.title: DOC 18 - 2026 Monza Event - DECISION - Car 25 - alleged failure to follow RDI at Turn 5
documents.subject: DECISION - Car 25 - alleged failure to follow RDI at Turn 5

details.fact: Car 25 (Bennett) failed to follow the Race Director instructions at the Turn 4/Turn 5 escape road.
details.infringement: Alleged breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code - item 25.2 of the Competition Notes.
details.decision: No further action.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Document 14) and heard the Driver of Car 25 (Bennett) and the team representative. They examined video evidence. The Driver of Car 25 explained that he saw Car 5 (Leon) leaving the track at Turn 1, and aborting his lap. At the time, Car 25 was on a push lap and was approaching Car 5 after Car 5 had re-joined the track. The Driver of Car 25 further explained that Car 5 did not leave the racing line while Car 25 was closing on him. In order to avoid a possible collision with Car 5 before the entry to Turn 4, the Driver of Car 25 decided to take avoiding action by leaving the track and crossing the chicane. Video evidence showed the Driver of Car 25, approaching Turn 4, and leaving the track by crossing the chicane. The Driver of Car 25 did not cross the gravel bed and was in a position to follow the Race Director’s instructions set out in Item 25.2 of the Event Notes by passing to the right of the yellow bollard. However, having considered the circumstances of the incident, the Stewards accepted the explanation provided by the Driver of Car 25. The Stewards nevertheless reminded the Driver that, once a car leaves the track at Turn 4, the instructions contained in Item 25.2 of the Competition Notes must be respected. Taking all the circumstances into consideration, the Stewards decided that No Further Action was appropriate.

documents.title: DOC 17 - 2026 Monza Event - INFRINGEMENT - Car 21 - failure to follow RDI at Turn 5
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 21 - failure to follow RDI at Turn 5

details.fact: Car 21 (Shields) failed to follow the Race Director instructions at the Turn 4/Turn 5 escape road.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code - item 25.2 of the Competition Notes.
details.decision: Warning given to the Driver of Car 21.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Document 13) and heard the Driver of Car 21 (Shields) and the team representative. They examined video evidence. The Stewards determined that the Driver of Car 21 approaching Turn 4 left the track by crossing the chicane. In this case the Stewards found that the Driver of Car 21 did not cross the gravel bed and was in position to follow the Race Director’s instructions (Event Notes Item 25.2) by passing to the right of the yellow bollard. The Driver of Car 21 explained that he thought he had gone through the gravel and he did not think that he needed to go around the bollard on that basis. The Stewards found the aforementioned Driver at fault and decided that the above warning is appropriate.
